systemInitialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity image showing TWO native macOS Glance system detail popovers side by side: CPU and Memory, as preview-only product concepts. Landscape 1536x1024 or similar. Crisp legible SF Pro-like text, native light Mac utility aesthetic, off-white translucent cards, graphite text, grey separators, subtle rounded corners and shadows on pale cool grey background. Restrained blue accents, green for healthy memory pressure. Match a compact menu bar utility, not a full desktop dashboard. Main canvas heading "Find what's using your Mac" with subtitle "Illustrative data · Click CPU or Memory to inspect". Each card roughly 380 logical px wide. Above each show a short menu bar icon strip CPU 24%, Memory 61%, Claude 58%, Codex 35%. Highlight CPU over left card and Memory over right card, with small pointer anchoring each respective popover. These are separate example states. No laptop photo or perspective.

LEFT CPU CARD:
Back chevron "Overview", centered "CPU", tiny blue live dot.
large "24%" label "Total CPU usage" beside a compact blue recent sparkline.
tiny chart labels "60 seconds ago" and "Now".
Section heading "Top processes", small grey "CPU ↓".
Five readable aligned rows, each icon and process name left, CPU percentage middle-right, memory far right. Column headers "Process", "CPU", "Memory".
"WindowServer" | "42.1%" | "486 MB"
"Google Chrome" | "31.6%" | "1.2 GB"
"Xcode" | "18.4%" | "2.1 GB"
"Claude" | "8.2%" | "624 MB"
"Codex" | "6.7%" | "512 MB"
Use recognizable restrained app icons; row padding generous, fine dividers. Small text beneath "Process CPU: 100% = one core" on one line, and "Total CPU is measured across all cores." This avoids confusing percentage scales.
Subtle "Updates every 2 seconds while open".
Bottom footer left text button "Show 10", right "Open Activity Monitor ↗".

RIGHT MEMORY CARD:
Back chevron "Overview", centered "Memory", live dot.
large "9.8 GB" next to muted "/ 16 GB"; smaller "Memory used" and compact blue recent sparkline.
A compact pale green banner "Memory pressure: Normal".
Two small inline metric pairs "Swap used  256 MB" and "Compressed  1.1 GB".
Section heading "Top processes", small grey "Memory ↓".
Aligned headers "Process", "Memory", "CPU".
"Xcode" | "2.1 GB" | "18.4%"
"Google Chrome" | "1.2 GB" | "31.6%"
"Claude" | "624 MB" | "8.2%"
"Codex" | "512 MB" | "6.7%"
"WindowServer" | "486 MB" | "42.1%"
Subtle "Includes visible processes, not all system memory."
Subtle "Updates every 2 seconds while open".
Bottom footer left "Show 10", right "Open Activity Monitor ↗".
No kill process buttons, no fake memory clean buttons, no prices, no extra dashboards, no heavy gradients. Keep panels beautifully aligned on same baseline, all lettering precise, readable, and unclipped.
